verdict.pick: HARRIS Diatomaceous Earth Powder Duster with 6 Inch Extension Nozzle
verdict.line: Picture a homeowner spraying DE into a tight crawl space. The Harris duster lets you reach corners without spilling. It is praised for its simple design and precise application, making it ideal for pest control. The catch: it only holds a small amount of powder at a time.
